e.summary_en: Credibility Transformer (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): CLS token attention as Bühlmann credibility, PyTorch + ICL (arXiv:2409.16653)

e.body:
insurance-credibility-transformer（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）是 Credibility Transformer 的 PyTorch 实现（arXiv:2409.16653 + ICL 扩展 arXiv:2409.xxxxx）：CLS token 的注意力权重作为 Bühlmann 可信度——把经典可信度理论嵌入 Transformer 架构。对 RIAA：经典精算方法与现代架构的融合——[[insurance-credibility]]（Bühlmann 经典）的深度学习方法；注意力权重有可信度解释（哪些历史数据点值得参考）；研究前沿（论文发表于 2024）；适合对可信度理论与深度学习的交叉感兴趣的 RIAA 学生。

## 同类工具
[[insurance-eqrn]]、[[insurance-multivariate-conformal]]、[[insurance-nflow]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
insurance-credibility-transformer (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) is the PyTorch implementation of the Credibility Transformer (arXiv:2409.16653 with ICL extension): CLS token attention weights as Bühlmann credibility — embedding classical credibility theory into a Transformer architecture. For RIAA: classical actuarial methods meet modern architectures — the deep-learning version of [[insurance-credibility]] (classical Bühlmann); attention weights carry a credibility interpretation (which historical data points deserve weight); research frontier (papers from 2024); suits RIAA students interested in the intersection of credibility theory and deep learning.

## Similar tools
[[insurance-eqrn]]、[[insurance-multivariate-conformal]]、[[insurance-nflow]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
